title: Quantifying Return on Security Controls in LLM Systems
authors: Richard Helder Moulton; Austin O'Brien; John D. Hastings
why_relevant: Evaluates security controls (ABAC, NER redaction, NeMo Guardrails) on a RAG system against attacks including prompt injection and PII leakage, quantifying defense effectiveness economically.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on financial risk/ROI metrics for security controls, not on robustness of retrieval/generation under unreliable evidence per se; minimal technical contribution to RAG robustness taxonomy.
